title: Two parallel neural ectoderm progenitors contribute to the developing brain
title_zh: 两个平行的神经外胚层祖细胞有助于大脑发育
abstract: When and how different brain regions diversify from one another remains unresolved. Does a common neural ectoderm progenitor generate the entire brain? Or do multiple neural ectoderm progenitors exist, each restricted to form specific brain regions? Here our lineage tracing studies of mouse embryos support the latter model. Two parallel brain progenitors emerge simultaneously during gastrulation: anterior neural ectoderm (forebrain/midbrain progenitor) and posterior neural ectoderm (hindbrain progenitor). Differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into anterior or posterior neural ectoderm-like cells revealed these were lineage committed to forebrain/midbrain versus hindbrain fates, respectively. They harbored diverging chromatin landscapes foreshadowing future forebrain/midbrain versus hindbrain identities. We further differentiated human pluripotent stem cells into hindbrain rhombomere 5/6-specific motor neurons, which were hitherto difficult to generate in vitro. Hence, we postulate the brain is a composite organ emanating from two lineage-restricted progenitors; these dual progenitors may be evolutionarily conserved across 550 million years from hemichordates to mammals.
abstract_zh: 大脑不同区域如何分化仍是一个未解之谜。是一个共同的神经外胚层祖细胞产生整个大脑？还是存在多个神经外胚层祖细胞，每个都被限制形成特定的大脑区域？在这里，我们对小鼠胚胎进行系谱追踪研究支持后者模型。两个平行的脑干祖细胞在胚层形成期同时出现：前神经外胚层（前脑/中脑祖细胞）和后神经外胚层（脑干祖细胞）。将人多能干细胞分化为前神经外胚层样细胞或后神经外胚层样细胞显示，这些细胞分别被限制为前脑/中脑命运或脑干命运。它们拥有不同的染色质景观，预示着未来前脑/中脑与脑干的身份认同。此外，我们将人多能干细胞分化为特定的脑干髓鞘突触前运动神经元，这些神经元此前在体外很难生成。因此，我们假设大脑是一个由两个限制性祖细胞组成的复合器官；这些双重祖细胞可能在从海鞘到哺乳动物的5亿年中得到保守保留。
